content: We ignore missing word embeddings because our dataset is quite small for retraining new word embeddings. However, if embeddings are extracted as separate discourse arguments, we used the average of all vectors of all discourse arguments in that message. Average embeddings have performed well for representing text sequences in other tasks BIBREF5 .
